item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-10-28

item.title: Introducing CKBSwap — Building on CKB for the Long Term (4 posts)
item.description: Hello, CKB community! We are FoundationLab, a team of three developers who share a strong belief in CKB and a commitment to building within its ecosystem. Today, we’d like to introduce CKBSwap, the project we’re working on. Our goal is straightforward: build a useful, accessible swap and liquidity application that helps turn CKB’s technical potential into something people can use. What is CKBSwap? CKBSwap is an exchange and liquidity application built around CKB’s native asset model. It is currently on testnet. It supports native CKB/xUDT and xUDT/xUDT liquidity pools using constant-product pricing. Users can swap assets, provide liquidity, and withdraw their share of the underlying...

item.title: Spark Program | NNCBN - Nervos Network Community Boot Nodes (1 posts)
item.description: 2026 October 27, Fifth Weekly Report We have been operating the node for the first synchronization since the last weekly report till today! Some fine-tuning is still needed, but the synchronization is already complete, and after about a week of operation, the system has already proven that it has sufficient performance reserves and is running stably. The next major step is to begin operations at the designated location. If all goes well, the next weekly report will announce that the node has been deployed and connected in the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of Africa, between Brazil and Portugal. We’re keeping our fingers crossed that everything goes smoothly. Initial LOG-Sort tests....
